notes.title: [3.0.0] UI and Performance
notes.content: [h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p]UI revamp[/p][/*][*][p]Activate auto-select when activating auto-use all items to reduce confusion[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory sorting also stack same items together[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Inventory flickers when enabling or disabling items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Refactorings[/h3][list][*][p]Sapling and Wheat seed put a counter on every round to reduce confusion[/p][/*][*][p]Payback based on how many rounds have passed instead of current round to maintain difficulty curve[/p][/*][*][p]Manage prop pooling to improve the performance of thousands of props[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-sort is always activated[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: [2.2.0] Kill the devil
notes.content:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] The devil has blood and killable now
[*] Add items Gunpowder, Bullet, and recipes
[*] Automatically play the fishing game if auto-use is activated
[*] Add item coal recipe
[*] The devil will ask the player to play for more rounds for every 20 rounds, as long as the player has blood
[*] Add a relic page and unlock information after the end of the game if the player kills the devil
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] All items enabled at the end of the round should respect the show filter
[/list]
[h3]Refactorings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revoke and refund the game round skill since it's a challenge, not an upgrade
[/list]

notes.title: [2.1.0] Artifact
notes.content:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add a item type tab to filter which type of items to show in the inventory
[*] Add audio compressor prevent sonic boom
[*] Add back to title button in the setting page
[*] Auto-scroll when mouse enters the beginning and end of inventory
[*] Add auto-sort the same item in the inventory
[*] Add item Artifact compression
[*] Fully upgraded item can be transformed by artifacts and brought to the new game
[*] Item can now automatically select required items
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fishing game was affected by game speed
[*] Incorrect poker profit calculation
[*] Item threesome and 69 also modulo decimal part
[*] Yacht game description width
[/list]
[h3]Refactorings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto-use item supports all types of items
[*] Cap the profit at the max integer in case someone reaches it
[*] Refresh is free but limited every round
[*] Revert the changes of Big Two, Devil's Toast, Jackpot, Queen of Spades, Sickle, and Poker. Since it's a good idea to let players keep the ability to gain profit instead of reducing it
[*] As stated above, massive item price and upgrade cost changes reflect the ability
[*] Remove and reduce wait time even more
[/list]

notes.title: [2.0.0] Fishing and precision
notes.content:
[h3]BREAKING CHANGES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Store the profit as an integer instead of a float number under the hood. This should prevent unwanted number rounding, in theory. The player's bank might be affected by this; otherwise, the game should feel the same
[/list]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ability to rearrange the item's order
[*] Add item fishing rod , fishing hook , fishing worm, steel ingot, and correspond recipes
[*] Add payback highlight based on the game round
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missing dice description and sub-view
[*] Missing playing card description and sub-view
[*] Refresh button is blocked by some UI elements
[*] Wheat's image doesn't display in the statistic list properly
[*] Wheat's particle doesn't display inside the list properly
[/list]

[h3]Refactorings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Make big two, devil's toast, jackpot, queen of spades, sickle, and poker less effective due to it being way too easy to let the number overflow[*] Automatically use the same protection items with the same name instead of the same item itself
[*] Change item boxing gloves, coins, mine, poker, and threesome's price for balance reason
[*] Leaderboard now has upgraded effect
[*] Make payback less drastic after round 50
[*] Remove or reduce wait time in the game
[/list]
